title: Enterprise export lockdown and network gates for admin console
creator: Asha Patel
description: Add a set of admin-level compliance toggles and hardened controls in the Admin Console to meet enterprise requirements. This ticket covers three related capabilities: 1) granular data export lockdown (disable exports, redact sensitive fields, require justification), 2) IP allowlisting gates with optional timebox and CIDR groups, and 3) a global "disable public sharing" enforcement that prevents link-sharing and public artifact exposures. Work must integrate with RBAC v2 roles and map SAML group claims into allowed toggle managers. All toggle changes must be recorded in the audit log with structured metadata and correlated change IDs for SIEM ingestion.
acceptance_criteria: Admin Console exposes three toggles: Export Lockdown, Network Allowlist (org-level), and Disable Public Sharing (org-level)
Toggles are scoped to RBAC v2 roles: only users with role 'compliance_admin' or explicit 'toggle_manager' permission can change them
Toggle state changes create an audit event with change_id, actor_id, timestamp, origin_ip, SAML_group_map, and justification if provided
Export Lockdown supports three modes: OFF, RESTRICTED (redact PII fields), and LOCKED (no exports allowed). Mode changes enforce policy at API/SDK layer
Network Allowlist accepts CIDR blocks and optional time windows (start/end ISO8601) and is enforced at the control plane and edge proxies
Disable Public Sharing must retroactively expire existing public links when enabled and record which artifacts were converted
All toggle changes are emitted to the audit stream endpoint and visible in the Console audit timeline within 60s
Feature flags backed by a migrating database schema and include a rollback path with configurable grace period
Automated tests cover permission enforcement, audit payload schema, and end-to-end enforcement on export endpoints
implementation_notes: Frontend: new admin settings page sections under 'Compliance' with toggle state, change modal, and justification input
API: /v1/admin/toggles endpoints with idempotent PATCH semantics, validation for CIDR and time windows
Auth: enforce via RBAC v2 middleware and SAML group claim translator (map 'legal_ops' -> compliance_admin)
Backend: persisted feature toggles in 'org_settings' table with change history and soft-deleted backup row
Edge: NGINX/proxy layer will pull allowlist rules periodically; fallback enforcement at control plane for inbound requests
Audit: enrich events with 'change_id' UUID and 'correlation_id' passed through downstream jobs (exports, sharing service)
testing_plan: Unit tests for toggle validation (CIDR parsing, time window overlap logic)
Integration tests: simulate SAML login with different group claims and assert toggle change permissions
E2E: enable Disable Public Sharing and verify existing public links are revoked and user-facing notices are created
Chaos: simulate audit stream outage and ensure toggle changes are queued and retried without losing change history
Load test: apply 10k concurrent export requests with Export Lockdown=RESTRICTED and confirm throughput and latency SLOs
rollout_plan: Feature gated behind runtime flag 'compliance_controls_v2' for 0% rollout in staging
Deploy backend and migrations on canary nodes, enable in 10% of orgs with automated smoke checks
Monitor audit delivery and revert if failure rate > 1% for 5 minutes
Gradually increase rollout to all orgs after two business days of stable metrics
Post-rollout: schedule a 24-hour follow-up to validate no unexpected export rejections
monitoring_and_alerts: Alert: Audit event delivery failure > 0.5% per minute to SIEM -> P0 pager
Alert: Unauthorized toggle change attempts > 10/min from same actor -> security-oncall
Dashboard: Toggle-change rate, average audit enrichment latency, number of retroactively revoked links
SLO: Audit event must be persisted and emitted to stream within 60 seconds for 99.9% of changes
